div.div: Approve stays disabled while a CRITICAL finding is open (acknowledge or dismiss it first). The server enforces the same guard (409 OPEN_CRITICAL_FINDINGS); approving against DECLINE or a hard stop needs a risk lead (403 ROLE_REQUIRED).
